csv_project_name: Developer for Country Club Road Site Development
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Montpelier seeks a developer(s) to partner with the City to construct a housing development on a city-owned parcel located at 203 Country Club Road. The property was purchased by the City in 2022 for the purposes of housing, recreation, and conservation. It is currently used for recreation and community services. The City has engaged in multiple phases of due diligence and community engagement and is open to any number of housing configurations and development build-out scenarios, with an eye to affordability and sustainability.
